questions: Which treatments change actual action/region selection and candidate output?
Which improve exact valid charged operation count under this bounded interface?
How do name framing, operative skill, retrieved memory, search tools, feedback and actual model differ?

models.route: included ChatGPT CLI; separate live content-free canaries returned exact ADAPTER_OK

replicate_seed_claim: IDs and randomized ordering only; CLI model RNG seed is not controllable or claimed
primary_contrasts: M-I: retrieved content relevance under approximate size control
O-M: order of same memory facts
second-model B versus primary B: actual backend at same effort setting
exploratory_contrasts: A-B: bundled change, not isolated causal attribution
common_prompt_facts: all prior action/visible feedback pairs from that trajectory only
no private correspondence; no access to outcome keys; no generated code

memory.source: Public training examples15/31 and index-dependency lesson; no final target-outcome tuning
memory.reordered: Identical relevant paragraphs reversed; order sensitivity, not relevance
memory.irrelevant: Nonmisleading archive/filename metadata prose matched by word count; token counts measured when available and exact tokenizer equivalence not claimed

skill: Separate frozen operative instruction packet about valid topological construction, charged helpers, deduplication, diverse regions and preserving valid incumbents; file hash pinned before first trajectory.
environment: harness/v1 release must be frozen by hash before experiment; no executable candidate code. Tool-off refuses construct/search; all attempted actions including refusals consume rounds.
final_evaluation: Identical independent exact-integer evaluator across all cells; lowest charged-cost valid candidate over all recorded candidates, M then canonical index-schedule identity for ties. No binary fallback counted as model success.
primary_metrics: unique candidate schedule identities and duplicate rates
secondary_metrics: same final witness across different actions
analysis: Four paired task×replicate observations per primary contrast; report each raw pair and descriptive summaries. Task is principal independent unit. No broad causal learning, global optimality, crypto speed/security or Apex runtime claim.

assignment.order: Python random.Random(seed).shuffle over all40 cells before launch; no optional stopping by outcome
assignment.concurrency: At most2 candidate CLI calls once harness/vendor support idle; with root+one reviewer no more4 active carriers

failure_rules: No automatic inference retry; preserve first output and censor typed failures
No native tool events allowed in candidate CLI stream; censor if observed
harness fixes require versioned release and prechange failures retained; affected cells rerun only as separately marked replacement
no new live call after horizon; preserve incomplete cells
blinding: Candidates have CLI native tools disabled and receive only experiment prompts/visible feedback. Shared OS filesystem is not an ACL isolation boundary. Oracle author freezes independent core before seeing harness implementation.
privacy: Own research authorized for GitHub/Slack. Raw email bodies, credentials and restricted checker material excluded.

spend.external_vendor: NOT_ADMITTED unless independent zero-cost route qualifies; no imputed vendor comparisons
